servers.description: List of NTP servers to synchronize with. Each entry specifies a server hostname or IP and optional options (e.g., 'iburst', 'prefer').

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP server.

options.description: List of options for this server (e.g., 'iburst', 'prefer', 'burst', 'noselect').

driftfile.description: Path to the file where NTP stores the clock frequency calibration.

keysfile.description: Path to the file containing symmetric keys for NTP authentication.

trustedkeys.description: List of key IDs (integers) that are trusted for authentication.

requestkey.description: Key ID used for client authentication requests (optional; set if NTP authentication is enabled).

controlkey.description: Key ID used for control messages (e.g., 'ntpq', 'ntpdc'; optional).

restrict_rules.description: Access control rules. Each entry defines flags and optionally a mask (IP address or 'nopeer' for global).

mask.description: IP address/mask to apply rule to (e.g., '192.168.0.0/24' or 'nopeer' for global).

broadcast_peers.description: List of IPv4 broadcast addresses to serve (rarely used).

multicast_peers.description: List of IPv4 multicast addresses to subscribe to (rarely used).

interface_addr.description: IP address to bind NTP listening socket to (e.g., '127.0.0.1'). Leave empty to bind to all interfaces.

leapfile.description: Path to leap seconds file (optional; required if leap second handling is needed).
